remainingFixtureIssues: Legacy descriptor cleanup assertions assume acquisition-order close.
Cross-device fixture does not model mount identity consistently.
Old inode-change fixture changes both observations identically.
Root cleanup now retains cleanup provenance via ResourceFailure.
One loaded.assert_not_called assertion was accidentally displaced outside its scope.

findings: Successful descriptor acquisition can precede a failing registry insertion.
Signal-mask change and previous-mask handoff can fail before restoration responsibility is established.

nextDecision.recommended: Use a single-use resource-isolated worker with parent-side proof of termination and an empty process group/cgroup; retain protected traversal and fail-closed result handling. Do not promise a generally reusable Python library immune to all asynchronous or allocation failures.
nextDecision.firstScope: local design, driver and simulations only
